authorityBoundary.currentEvidence: No claim becomes CURRENT_DATA until admitted through current-evidence authority/freshness/provenance rules.
authorityBoundary.currentPosition: No current runtime position is assigned from date or structural prose alone.
authorityBoundary.signals: Observation targets remain STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE until current evidence admits an OBSERVED_SIGNAL.
authorityBoundary.threshold: Observation thresholds are qualitative and human-governed; no synthetic score.
authorityBoundary.projection: Reachable positions remain CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION and are empty while current position/threshold evidence is unadmitted.
